# Gathering & Crafting Requirements Quality Checklist

**Purpose**: Đánh giá chất lượng, tính đầy đủ, độ rõ ràng và tính nhất quán của bộ yêu cầu khai thác tài nguyên và chế tạo đa trạm (`006-gathering-crafting`).
**Created**: 2026-11-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all five world resource node categories (`TREE`, `STONE`, `ORE_VEIN`, `HERB_PATCH`, `FISHING_SPOT`) and their required server-side validation rules (range, tool tier, stamina, remaining charges, inventory space) explicitly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Are respawn timer bands for starter, mid-tier, and high-tier regions explicitly defined and bound solely to server clock time? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Are all 36 canonical recipes (22 MVP) and 8 recipe categories tied unambiguously to the single source of truth `game-data/recipes.json` without hardcoded duplication? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Constitution §III]
- [ ] CHK004 Are station access preconditions (primary building, alternate station building, public NPC station, required station level, active building status, and unlock conditions) completely enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]

## Requirement Clarity & Measurability

- [ ] CHK005 Are interaction proximity (`<= 96 px`), batch size bounds (`1..50`), stamina costs (`8` heavy / `4` light), and auto-pull storage threshold (`bld_storage` Lv `>= 2`) quantified without ambiguous phrasing? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the exact deduction order for `autoPullFromStorage` (bag first, then homestead storage) and its exclusion at public NPC stations unambiguously stated? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK007 Are crafting queue cancellation refund rules (`80%` floor materials and `80%` Gold) clearly quantified to prevent stash-abuse exploits? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK008 Are station efficiency modifiers (smelting speed bonus, double portion/potion chance, workshop material savings) explicitly required to be computed server-side? [Measurability, Spec §FR-008]

## Requirement Consistency & Constitution Alignment

- [ ] CHK009 Do all persistence and transaction requirements consistently specify local JSON files (`world/<regionId>.json`, `characters/<id>.json`, `inventories/<id>.json`, `ledgers/currency-ledger-*.json`) with JSON WAL and zero external DBMS/third-party services? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-007, Constitution §I]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the reconciliation between the 36 recipes (22 MVP) in `game-data/recipes.json` and the earlier `>= 30 / 14 MVP` minimum baseline clearly documented without contradiction? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §SC-002]

## Edge Cases, Concurrency & Anti-Cheat Coverage

- [ ] CHK011 Are concurrent node contention (last charge race), concurrent crafting double-spend, idempotent replay (`>= 24h`), and full-inventory pre-check failure behaviors completely defined? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK012 Are interruption rules during gathering (damage, stun, out-of-range movement), station-upgrading locks, and abnormal bot-pattern audit logging explicitly addressed without third-party anti-cheat services? [Security, Spec §Edge Cases, Constitution §II]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after human/lead review confirms each requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
